emulator._source: the world's own client installs a Cemu graphic pack and listens on port 45872 for what that pack posts back (XENO_DEFAULT_PORT = 45872). The emulator side is the world's own business.

client._kind_source: The world registers its own Archipelago client and carries the code that talks to the emulator, so London installs the apworld and starts the emulator only. Its own registration, read from the package's __init__.py: `components.append(Component("Xenoblade X Client", func=launch_client, component_type=Type.CLIENT, game_name="Xenoblade X", supports_uri=True))`
